where.description: Where this was learned, specific enough to find again: a file and its lines, a document's title and folder, a meeting and its date, the role that said it. Never a person's name.

kind.description: What kind of place it is; sets how often the source review lists it as due.

learned.description: The day it was read or heard. Quote it in YAML. Never moved once written.

checked.description: The last day someone re-read or re-asked it and it still said the same.

link.description: A URL or a path to re-open it.

supports.description: The record's top-level fields this source backs, e.g. trigger, steps, cadence.

recheck_by.description: Re-read by this day, overriding the kind's interval (a plan that ends in June).

title: Process record
description: One recurring piece of human work with a purpose: what starts it, what it reads, who does it, where the evidence lands. Metadata about work, never the work itself.

visibility.description: Who may see this record. public may leave the organization; staff, any signed-in staff member; internal, the technology, data and records team; restricted, the owning role and the sponsor's office. A staff or public record names no infrastructure outside source and signal.

data.description: The system fact the trigger reads. Technical; never shown below internal.

surfaced_by.description: The screen, report or tool that shows it.

role.description: A role record's key. Never a person, never free text; put the qualifier in note.

note.description: What this role does in this process, when the role record does not say.

location.description: Where completion is recorded. null means nowhere, which is a finding.

node.description: A key in your systems map (app:, job:, base:, vendor:, sis:). Keep one list of those keys and check against it.

owner.description: The role accountable for the rule. A role record's key.

automated.description: Which step a job does, or 'nothing'.

sop.description: Where the human how-to lives: a knowledge-base key or a URL. The record is the model; the SOP is the manual. null means none exists yet.
